info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Ecommerce Cart Coupons-v2-spec
info.description: The List Ecommerce Cart Coupons API provides retailers with the ability to retrieve active coupons associated with a customer's shopping cart. This endpoint allows businesses to show personalized discounts to enhance customer experience and drive conversions. Typical consumers of this API include frontend applications that display coupons during the checkout process. By utilizing this API, developers can ensure their shopping cart flow is enhanced with dynamic promotional offers, ultimately promoting higher sales and customer satisfaction.

get.summary: Retrieve coupon details from the cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the details of the applied coupon in the cart, including validation status and discount information. Use this to ensure users receive the correct discounts during checkout.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to apply a coupon to the shopping cart. Ensure that the coupon code is valid to receive applicable discounts.
